name: Société Générale
note: French bank listed on Euronext Paris with widely held shares (societe-generale-ownership). On the upper back of all French national rugby teams' shirts under its 2024-2028 'partenaire premium' deal with the FFR. A September 2025 Paris Court of Appeal finding of discrimination (sex and origin) against the bank is on file (societe-generale-discrimination-2025).
